title: Button density & contrast audit and restore icon-only focus affordance
creator: Priya Shah
description: We observed multiple regressions after the token migration and compact-spacing experiment: icon-only buttons lost a visible keyboard focus ring in compact density, primary/ghost contrast ratios for small CTA sizes drop below 4.5:1 in dark theme, and form toolbars are more cramped than the design intent. This ticket is an audit + design spec to 1) analyze density and contrast regressions across variants and sizes, 2) restore a consistent, accessible focus affordance for icon-only buttons (compact and regular), and 3) propose token changes and fallback guidelines for the engineering team to implement in runtime and component library.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Documented contrast matrix for all button variants (primary, secondary, ghost, link) across light/dark themes and size scales (xs/sm/md/lg). 2) Design spec that reintroduces a keyboard-visible focus treatment for icon-only buttons that meets WCAG 2.1 AA (contrast and focus target) for both compact and regular densities. 3) Token migration plan with minimal footprint for runtime (list of tokens to change and suggested fallback values). 4) Visual regressions list with screenshots and recommended fixes, reviewed and approved by Eng + PM. 5) UX smoke test checklist for QA and a small playground PR with storybook examples.
decisions:
- Keep primary fill colors but increase elevated stroke for ghost/outline at small sizes to maintain contrast.
- Reintroduce an explicit focus ring for icon-only buttons: 2px solid focus color with 4px outer gap (visual padding) in compact density, fallback to 3px in touch-dense contexts.
- Introduce two new tokens: --button-focus-offset-compact and --button-focus-offset-regular to control visual gap without changing hit target.
- Don't change hit target minimums; use focus visuals only to avoid regressions to tap targets.
implementation_notes:
- Provide token mappings and CSS variables for frontend: ensure runtime respects user-chosen density (compact/regular).
- Work with Eng to expose a theme-safe contrast check in the build pipeline (warn if any button variant falls <4.5:1).
- Add storybook stories for keyboard-only flows and high-contrast mode.
- Coordinate with QA for visual snapshot tests that include dark theme + compact density.
